description.en: A native SDK example that watches module switches and configuration, supplies translations, and optionally controls a module or runs commands.
description.zh: 原生 SDK 示例：观察模块开关和配置变化，自带翻译词条，可选联动开关和执行客户端命令。

description.en: Watches another module's switch and configuration, reports changes, and can run separate commands when the watched module turns on or off.
description.zh: 观察另一个模块的开关和配置变化，可分别在目标开启、关闭时执行命令，并演示可选的模块联动。

Watched Module.en: Use the original English module name, for example Clock. Changes apply after toggling this module.
Watched Module.zh: 填写原始英文模块名，例如 Clock。修改后重新启用本模块生效。

Control Watched Module.en: Requests activation using the client's normal permission and confirmation checks.
Control Watched Module.zh: 通过客户端正常权限检查和确认流程请求开启目标模块。

Notify Changes.en: Reports changes to the watched module's switch and configuration while this extension module is enabled.
Notify Changes.zh: 本扩展模块开启期间，通知观察目标的开关及配置变化。

Enable Command.en: One client command beginning with /. Runs when the watched module switches on, not when this extension module starts.
Enable Command.zh: 以 / 开头的单条客户端命令，观察目标由关变开时执行，而非启动本扩展时执行。

Disable Command.en: One client command beginning with /. Runs when the watched module switches off.
Disable Command.zh: 以 / 开头的单条客户端命令，观察目标由开变关时执行。
